curatorWhy: 女子爵士 supergroup ARTEMIS 的第三張 Blue Note 作品，也是換成五人編制後的第一張。③ `bluenote.com/artist/artemis/`（200）逐字寫 `Fresh off their 2nd consecutive win for “Jazz Group of the Year” in the DownBeat Readers Poll, ARTEMIS returns with their third Blue Note album ARBORESQUE featuring a new quintet line-up of the band helmed by pianist and musical director Renee Rosnes with trumpeter Ingrid Jensen , tenor saxophonist Nicole Glover , bassist Noriko Ueda , and drummer Allison Miller .`——**「third Blue Note album」是可引用的廠牌目錄序數（第 1714 條的 ③ 來源），本卡據此記為「第三張 Blue Note 專輯」，只記這一層。** 同頁對編制逐字評 `Miller is “the band’s center of gravity as well as being a gifted orchestrator behind the drumkit.” Together with Rosnes and Ueda, the rhythm section puts power and finesse in perfect equilibrium.`。八軌裡第 5 軌是 Wayne Shorter 的〈Footprints〉、第 7 軌是 Bacharach／David 的〈What the World Needs Now Is Love〉，其餘六首為團員自作（〈The Smile of the Snake〉〈Komorebi〉〈Sights Unseen〉〈Petrichor〉〈Olive Branch〉〈Little Cranberry〉）。實掃 `ARTEMIS` 於 seed 17,248 列 0 命中；卡單／prop 層有一筆 `c165/prop-a.json` 的《ARTEMIS》(2020)，**盤名不同、複合折鍵零命中**，本卡沿用同一個全大寫字串（c-165 a 第 1918 條已實查定案）。
